moments.title: Autumnal Equinox Marks New Season
moments.blurb: The astronomical start of autumn in the Northern Hemisphere began on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, at 00:05 UTC (1:05 AM BST).

angles.name: Crisp Air & Pumpkin Spice
angles.copy: That's it, summer's officially packed its bags! Hello, astronomical autumn. Time for cosy nights, crunchy leaves, and all things pumpkin spice. What's your favourite thing about the new season?

angles.name: Equal Day, Equal Night
angles.copy: Did you feel the shift? The autumnal equinox means roughly equal day and night across the globe. We're officially in the season of shorter days and longer nights now. Perfect for stargazing!

angles.name: New Season, New Playlist
angles.copy: Autumn has officially arrived! What's on your soundtrack for the changing leaves and cooler weather? Drop your ultimate autumn anthems below!

moments.title: Great British Bake Off Series 17 Underway
moments.blurb: The seventeenth series of The Great British Bake Off began on Tuesday, September 22, 2026, on Channel 4, featuring new judge Nigella Lawson alongside Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: Bake Off Buzz
angles.copy: Did you catch the start of the new Bake Off series this week? Nigella Lawson in the tent is already a game-changer! Who impressed you most with their bakes?

angles.name: Tuesday Night Treat
angles.copy: It's a new era for Bake Off! If you missed the first episode on Tuesday, catch up now on All4. Get ready for weekly doses of soggy bottoms and showstoppers!

angles.name: New Judge Alert
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a Bake Off judge? We are HERE for it. What did you think of the new judging panel and the fresh batch of bakers?

moments.title: Strictly Live Shows Kick Off This Weekend
moments.blurb: Following its launch show on September 19, 2026, the live competitive shows for Strictly Come Dancing Series 24 begin on Saturday, September 26, 2026, on BBC One.

angles.name: Strictly Saturday
angles.copy: The Glitterball race officially begins! Strictly Come Dancing's first live show is this Saturday. Who are you backing to dazzle on the dancefloor?

angles.name: Dance Off Countdown
angles.copy: It's almost time for the first dances! Get ready for the competitive action as Strictly goes live on Saturday night. Who do you think will be top of the leaderboard?

angles.name: New Hosts, First Live Show
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are your new Strictly hosts! How will they fare on the first live show this weekend? Tune in to BBC One Saturday night!

moments.title: Avril Lavigne Turns 42
moments.blurb: Canadian pop-punk icon Avril Lavigne, known for hits like 'Complicated' and 'Sk8er Boi,' celebrates her 42nd birthday on September 27, 2026.

angles.name: Sk8er Girl Turns 42
angles.copy: Happy 42nd Birthday to the queen of pop-punk, Avril Lavigne! Still rocking our world since 'Complicated'. What's your favourite Avril track?

angles.name: Pop Punk Princess
angles.copy: Can you believe Avril Lavigne is 42 on Sunday? She brought pop-punk to the mainstream and inspired a generation. Which of her anthems is stuck in your head today?

angles.name: Avril's Legacy
angles.copy: From 'Sk8er Boi' to 'Girlfriend,' Avril Lavigne has given us so many iconic bangers. Wishing a very happy 42nd birthday to a true music legend!

moments.title: Gwen Stefani Turns 57
moments.blurb: No Doubt frontwoman and solo pop superstar Gwen Stefani celebrates her 57th birthday on October 3, 2026.

angles.name: No Doubt, Still Fabulous
angles.copy: She's just a girl, and she's turning 57! Happy Birthday to the incredible Gwen Stefani on October 3rd. What's your favourite No Doubt or solo track?

angles.name: Hollaback Girl Forever
angles.copy: Gwen Stefani hits 57 next week! From ska-punk icon to pop powerhouse, her style and sound are unmistakable. Celebrate her birthday with us – what song should we play?

angles.name: Style Icon at 57
angles.copy: Happy 57th Birthday to the one and only Gwen Stefani! Her fashion and music have influenced generations. What's her most iconic look or song for you?

moments.title: Bruno Mars Turns 41
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning singer, songwriter, and performer Bruno Mars, known for hits like 'Uptown Funk' and 'Just the Way You Are,' celebrates his 41st birthday on October 8, 2026.

angles.name: 24K Magic at 41
angles.copy: It's a party! Bruno Mars turns 41 on October 8th. Get ready to groove – what's your go-to Bruno Mars track for instant good vibes?

angles.name: Birthday Funk
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 41st Birthday to the incredibly talented Bruno Mars next week! From 'Grenade' to 'Uptown Funk', his music is pure magic. What's your favourite?

angles.name: Pop Icon Turns 41
angles.copy: Bruno Mars, the king of catchy tunes and smooth moves, celebrates his 41st birthday soon! What's your favourite Bruno Mars song to sing along to?
